config.admin_superusers_description: Whether to treat all admins as superusers
config.qq_bound_max_number_description: Maximum number of QQ accounts each player can bind; set to 0 for no limit
config.command_groups_description: The bot only responds to commands sent in these platform groups
config.message_groups_description: Groups that receive game messages and whose chat is synced into the game
config.command_minecraft_whitelist_description: Only Minecraft commands starting with an entry in this list may run via the Command command; leave the blacklist empty when using it
config.command_minecraft_blacklist_description: Minecraft commands starting with an entry in this list are blocked from running via the Command command
config.broadcast_server_description: Whether to announce server startup and shutdown to other servers and message groups
config.broadcast_player_description: Whether to announce players joining or leaving the server
config.broadcast_update_description: When a new version is detected, send a one-time update notice to message groups on bot connection
config.sync_command_panels_description: Whether to sync UniBot commands as group command panels for official QQ bots; when disabled, leftover panels are removed on bot connection
config.sync_all_qq_message_description: Whether to forward every message group message into the server; when disabled, use the send command to send messages
config.sync_all_game_message_description: Whether to forward every in-server message to message groups
config.sync_message_between_servers_description: Whether to forward in-server messages to other servers
config.sync_sensitive_words_description: Messages containing any listed word are not synced to message groups; players see a prohibited-content notice instead
config.sync_color_source_description: Minecraft color used for the source part when forwarding group and cross-server messages
config.sync_color_player_description: Minecraft color used for the player name part when forwarding group and cross-server messages
config.sync_color_message_description: Minecraft color used for the content part when forwarding group and cross-server messages
config.bot_prefix_description: Name prefix of fake players used for list command grouping and join broadcast detection; leave empty if not needed
config.list_compatible_mode_description: Updates the player list by watching join and leave events; for servers whose list cannot be read directly, though data may be inaccurate
config.whitelist_command_description: Name of the Minecraft command your server uses to manage its whitelist
config.image__mode_description: Render outgoing bot messages as images; requires extra image dependencies and slows down responses
config.webui__enabled_description: Whether to enable the WebUI panel and mount the Web API and WebSocket on the bot port

env.HOST_description: IP or host name NoneBot listens on; use 0.0.0.0 for public access
env.SUPERUSERS_description: User IDs (such as QQ numbers) with admin privileges
env.DRIVER_description: Driver combination NoneBot runs on; maintained automatically when installing or uninstalling adapters
env.ONEBOT_ACCESS_TOKEN_description: AccessToken of the OneBot V11 platform, set on the OneBot server side; leave empty if unused
env.QQ_BOTS_description: List of QQ Open Platform official bots; each bot needs an AppID and Secret and subscribes to events (Intents) as needed. Configure the callback URL on the open platform when using WebHook.
env.QQ_IS_SANDBOX_description: Whether to enable QQ sandbox mode, disabled by default
env.TELEGRAM_BOTS_description: List of Telegram bots; request the Token from @BotFather (required). Uses Long Polling by default; Webhook needs a public HTTPS address.
env.TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_URL_description: Public HTTPS address for webhook mode, such as https://yourdomain.com; leave empty for Long Polling
env.TELEGRAM_PROXY_description: Proxy address for reaching the Telegram API, such as http://127.0.0.1:10809; install httpx[socks] for Socks proxies
env.DISCORD_BOTS_description: List of Discord bots; each bot needs a Bot Token and subscribes to events (Intents) as needed. message_content is a privileged Intent and must be enabled on the developer portal.
env.DISCORD_API_VERSION_description: Discord API version number, defaults to 10
env.DISCORD_API_TIMEOUT_description: Discord API request timeout in seconds, defaults to 30
env.DISCORD_COMPRESS_description: Whether to enable gateway payload compression, disabled by default
env.DISCORD_HANDLE_SELF_MESSAGE_description: Whether to process messages sent by the bot itself, disabled by default
env.DISCORD_PROXY_description: Proxy address for reaching the Discord API, such as http://127.0.0.1:6666; leave empty if unused
env.DODO_BOTS_description: List of DoDo Open Platform bots (WebSocket connection only); create a bot on the open platform to get the client_id and token.
env.KAIHEILA_BOTS_description: List of KOOK bots; get the Token on the developer platform (required).
env.SATORI_CLIENTS_description: List of Satori protocol clients for connecting to Satori servers such as Chronocat, LLBot, and Koishi.
env.MINECRAFT_WS_URLS_description: Minecraft WebSocket connections: server name → list of addresses (multiple addresses per server supported)
env.MINECRAFT_ACCESS_TOKEN_description: Token for the Minecraft WebSocket connection; leave empty if unset
env.QQ_BOTS_form_qr_hint: Scan the QR code with the mobile QQ app to fill in the AppID and Secret automatically
env.QQ_BOTS_field_id_description: AppID of the QQ Open Platform application
env.QQ_BOTS_field_secret_description: Secret of the QQ Open Platform application, used for message signing and event verification
env.QQ_BOTS_field_token_description: Bot Token of the QQ Open Platform application, only needed for WebSocket connections
env.QQ_BOTS_field_intent_description: Only takes effect over WebSocket; subscribe to the events your bot type requires
env.QQ_BOTS_field_use_websocket_description: When disabled, connects via WebHook instead; configure the callback URL on the open platform
env.TELEGRAM_BOTS_field_is_webhook_descripti: Falls back to Long Polling when disabled (recommended)
env.DISCORD_BOTS_field_token_description: Bot Token of the application in the Discord Developer Portal
env.DISCORD_BOTS_field_message_content_descr: Privileged Intent; enable Message Content Intent on the developer portal
env.DISCORD_BOTS_field_application_commands_: Command name → list of server IDs; {"*": ["*"]} registers everything as global commands
env.DODO_BOTS_field_client_id_description: Client ID of the bot on the DoDo Open Platform
env.DODO_BOTS_field_token_description: Token of the bot on the DoDo Open Platform
env.KAIHEILA_BOTS_field_token_description: Token obtained under KOOK developer platform → Application → Bot connection mode
env.SATORI_CLIENTS_field_host_description: Listening address of the Satori server, such as localhost
env.SATORI_CLIENTS_field_port_description: Listening port of the Satori server, 5500 by default for Chronocat
env.SATORI_CLIENTS_field_path_description: Custom listening path of the server, such as /satori; empty by default
env.SATORI_CLIENTS_field_token_description: Authentication Token required by the server (needed for Chronocat, for example)
env.SATORI_CLIENTS_field_secure_description: Whether to connect encrypted via TLS / wss
